answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The inlet of work and the beacon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a saffron to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
